_note: Neutral sample templates for the operations workbook drop (docs/04 M2 ops-drop-import). A workbook is matched by its signature: the sheet names plus the SHA-256 of the header row's cells on headerSheet joined by the unit separator U+001F (headerHash). A workbook that matches no template is refused with a message naming its sheets. columns maps each header cell onto a column of config/accounting_layout.json, so a matched workbook stages through the accounting import's linking, diff and rules. Add the real templates only after merge.
